title: Nordic - A cross-country skiing game you can play with your friends!
author: ClubChaos
selftext:
Hey all!

Nordic is a cross-country skiing game all about skill expression and enjoying the calm of the trails. My focus making this game was to translate the real feeling of nordic skiing and map those physical movements onto the controller as closely as I can. I thought, for what nordic skiing lacks in adrenaline, it can make up for with detail in control in a video game. By giving control to each of your limbs I think it achieves a fairly tactile experience and for me that's a huge thing with my enjoyment in a game.

Nordic can be played single player but the intended experience is to ski around with your friends and have fun! It is also preferable to play with a controller!

The ai impact:  I am a senior developer by trade but threejs is foreign territory for me.  Using cursor has been a god send to expedite development but also my own learning process.  Over the last few months I have learned so much about game development on web apps and ai is truly a blessing to be able to make this dream a reality.  I previously attempted to make this same game in godot and I can safely say the product here is far better realized than my "artisanal" creation.  The key here is approaching ai usage as a tool.
